function: Joint DRL control of UAV 3D trajectory, user scheduling and slot duration with RIS phase alignment, maximizing energy efficiency of a RIS-assisted UAV downlink (pp. 5-8).
system: Single-antenna rotary-wing UAV, K=6 single-antenna ground users served by TDMA, passive reflecting UPA RIS with M=20-150 elements, 1.8 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 12).
method: TD3 deep reinforcement learning (actor, two critics, delayed policy update, target smoothing; three 60-neuron layers, Adam) trained in simulation; SAC, DDPG, DDQN as comparisons (pp. 6-9, 12).
data_channel: Own simulator: blocking-probability LoS/NLoS air-to-ground model (environment constants 9.61, 0.16), distance path loss, UPA steering vectors, random user positions; no dataset or measurement (pp. 5, 11-12).
test_conditions: Agents trained and evaluated per set-up in the same simulated environment; sweeps over RIS elements, power, rate threshold, users, heights, RIS position; no test in an unseen scenario (pp. 12-15).
baselines: SAC, DDPG, DDQN with optimized RIS phase; DDPG with random RIS phase; DDPG without RIS; gains over no-RIS benchmark also contrasted with earlier [14], [33] (pp. 12-13).
metrics: Average propulsion energy, throughput and energy efficiency versus episodes, RIS elements, power, rate threshold, users, height range, RIS position; execution time per step (pp. 12-15).
complexity: Training order O[Et Se Ms x sum of layer-width products]; execution order O[sum of actor layer-width products]; TD3 runtime 0.031 s per step (pp. 10-11, 13).
q1_support: p. 5: "blocking probability when the UAV-user signal is blocked". Custom LoS/NLoS blocking model with UPA steering vectors and constants in Table III (p. 12); no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 15: "difficulty converging due to the higher state and action space". Sweeps over K, RIS elements, power, rate threshold, heights and RIS position (pp. 12-15) read as separate trainings; no trained policy is tested in an unseen scenario or adapted.
q3_support: p. 12: "be used: (i) The DDPG with random RIS phase shift". Non-learned: random RIS phase (DDPG-RRP) and no RIS (DDPG-NR); learned: SAC-ORP, DDPG-ORP, DDQN-ORP on the same problem, compared on propulsion energy, throughput and EE (Figs. 5-15, Table VI).
q4_support: p. 10: "The complexity of the proposed TD3 algorithm depends on". Orders C_T and C_E are given on p. 11; execution time per step of TD3 is 0.031 s in Table V (p. 13).
q5_support: p. 12: "Python 3.9.13 and TensorFlow 2.14. All the algorithms: TD3,". Custom simulation in Python; no code link, DOI, repository or data-availability statement, and the channel data are generated, not public.
